After recently allowing iPhone users to add a second account within the same app, WhatsApp is now expanding support to up to three accounts. Here are the details.

WhatsApp to Support Up to Three Accounts

Last June, WhatsApp officially rolled out multi-account support on iPhone, allowing users to add a second account within the same app.

After several months of beta testing, the feature was officially launched, giving users another option and eliminating the need to rely on WhatsApp Business to manage a second account.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is now developing an expansion of this feature, enabling users to switch between three accounts without having to log out.

WABetaInfo reports:

The report adds that each account will keep its own chat history, notifications, privacy settings, backups, and media files.

WABetaInfo points out that while two accounts are sufficient for most users, the new feature will be quite useful for those who need to use different combinations of work and personal phone numbers at the same time.

However, the feature is still in development and has not yet been opened to beta testers, and it is expected to be some time before it is officially released.
